ev.q: the first title in the series to be set primarily during World War II
The multiplayer was praised for returning to boots-on-the-ground gameplay
Players can choose one of five (later eight) divisions
The player is accompanied by friendly troops throughout the game
Praise was given towards its story
They also chose to include atrocities and Nazi concentration camps in the campaign mode
Praise was given towards its story, the changes to combat, multiplayer modes, and visuals
In some parts of the campaign, players are able to control vehicles
